thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated inference latency observed for model group 'redwood-embed-v2' in ap-east-1. Incident INC-2026-321. Paging oncall: marie.
marie (oncall): Ack. Jumping in. Oncall is taking lead for triage. @dan can you own public comms / status page drafts?
dan: On it. I'll hold off publishing until we have a concise initial impact line.
anita (sre): Quick findings so far — KV cache churn on several inference hosts (OOM-driven evictions) causing additional KV fetches and 200–800ms extra p99 for embedding requests. Error rate for generation endpoints is normal. No data loss.
liz (support-lead): Seeing multiple customer tickets about slow search/rec results in APAC. Enterprise customers flagged in Zendesk. Escalating to CSMs now.
jordan (product-comms): Drafting a short, clear status update. Suggest: "Partial latency increases for embeddings in APAC; no data loss. Engineers investigating; mitigation underway." Need exact affected scope (regions, product areas) to be precise.
marie (oncall): That wording looks good. Add estimated user impact: "affects ~5–10% of embedding requests routed to ap-east-1; user-facing features like search/recs may be slower"
dan: Draft below — please review. I will publish the initial update if there are no objections in 5m.
```
Initial status (DRAFT):
- Incident: INC-2026-321
- Impact: Partial increase in latency for embeddings served from ap-east-1. Approx 5–10% of requests see degraded performance; no errors or data loss observed.
- Current status: Engineering investigating. Mitigation underway (cache tuning + canary restarts).
- ETA: 30–60 minutes for monitoring impact of the first mitigation wave.
```
marie (oncall): +1 with one tweak: change ETA to "monitoring for impact; further updates in 30 minutes" (we can't promise 30–60).
jordan (product-comms): +1. I'll tighten customer-facing language after publishing (concise, no ops detail).
dan: Publishing initial status update to the public status page now (will mark as initial). Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-321 (internal draft posted).
incident-bot: NOTE: statuspage-bot posted an internal draft. Visibility: internal-only.
sukh (eng): Running immediate mitigation: increase KV cache quota from 2GB -> 4GB on a subset (20%) of inference hosts in ap-east-1; queueing rolling restarts for the canary group.
anita (sre): Canary restarts in progress. Monitoring p95/p99. Expect 10–15 minute stabilization window after each node restart.
marie (oncall): Handoff note: I'll be on-call for the next 25 minutes then handing to @dan for overnight monitoring. Dan — please post the next status update when we have canary metrics.
dan: Acknowledged. Preparing update template now.
```
Planned update template:
- Update n (time): Engineering applied cache increases to 20% of nodes. Observed p95 improved from X -> Y; p99 showing early signs of improvement. Still monitoring.
- Next steps: expand to remaining nodes if metrics continue to improve.
- Customer impact: still partial latency for a minority of requests; no errors/data loss.
```
liz (support-lead): Sending customer notification template to support queue. We will notify enterprise customers with the short summary + link to status page.
incident-bot: UPDATE: Canary group updated — cache increased on 8 hosts. Telemetry: p95 embeddings latency down ~18%, p99 down ~9% (early).
dan: Posting second public update (Periodic Update 1) now with the measured numbers and next steps.
jordan (product-comms): Editing the public text to remove raw numbers and keep relative improvement phrasing for external audience.
incident-bot: PUBLIC UPDATE PUBLISHED: "Engineers applied mitigations to a subset of hosts in ap-east-1; latency for affected requests is improving. We will expand mitigations while monitoring. No data loss."
marie (oncall): Good. Also add a short note for customers using dedicated/dedicated zones: "Dedicated capacity customers on pinned hosts unaffected."
jordan (product-comms): Added that line.
sukh (eng): Starting expansion to remaining hosts (rolling, 2 at a time) — will take ~40 minutes.
anita (sre): Monitoring: during expansion we may see transient latency blips <5 minutes per restart. We'll call that out if we hit it.
dan: Noted. I'll include that in the next public update if we observe it.
liz (support-lead): Support template ready. Snippet we send to customers: 
```
Hi <Customer>,
We're investigating increased latency for embedding-powered features in APAC. Engineers applied mitigations and are expanding them cluster-wide. You may see short periods of slower responses during restarts. No data loss. See https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-321 for live updates.
Thanks for your patience — support team is available if you need help.
```
incident-bot: MONITOR: Expansion to remaining hosts started at +00:35 since incident open.
sukh (eng): Expansion complete. Post-expansion telemetry: p95 down ~23%, p99 down ~18% vs peak. Error rates unchanged.
anita (sre): Observing stable metrics for 12 minutes after last restart. Rolling restarts fixed the KV churn root cause; we also applied a kernel setting tweak to reduce OOMs.
marie (oncall): Thanks team. I'm marking this as resolved in 10 minutes if metrics remain stable. Dan — can you prepare the resolved post with brief RCA and link to postmortem stub?
dan: Will do. Draft resolved notice below for quick review.
```
Resolved (DRAFT):
- Incident: INC-2026-321 — Resolved
- Summary: A subset of inference hosts experienced KV cache evictions causing increased latency for embedding requests in ap-east-1. Engineers applied cache quota increases, performed rolling restarts, and deployed a kernel-level tweak to reduce OOM churn.
- Impact: ~5–10% of embedding requests in ap-east-1 experienced higher latency for ~1.5 hours. No data loss.
- Mitigation: Rolling restarts + cache tuning + kernel tweak.
- Next steps: Full postmortem and follow-up fixes (persistent cache sizing, additional OOM safeguards). Postmortem link (TBD).
```
jordan (product-comms): +1. I'll make the external text shorter and add the postmortem link later.
liz (support-lead): We'll send a closing note to affected enterprise customers with the resolved summary and contact info.
incident-bot: RESOLVED NOTICE PUBLISHED: public status updated to Resolved. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-321
marie (oncall): Closing handoff: metrics stable for 20+ minutes, handing back to regular oncall rota. Thanks everyone.
sukh (eng): Filing follow-up tasks in the incident board for persistent cache sizing and adding OOM probes.
dan: Final note — I'll pin the public resolved message and add the postmortem stub to #postmortems and link in the status page update later.
marie (oncall): Great work. One action: please ensure support tickets get the resolved template and the postmortem link when ready.
liz (support-lead): On it. I'll add the postmortem link once posted.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-321 closed."
